description: A reusable policy in which the teacher starts from a planned entry point, records what learners show sustained interest in, webs that interest to content worth learning (and to required standards), follows the thread with guided activity, and closes it on a product or shared account; expected to deepen engagement and self-directed inquiry, mainly with young children and with an adult guiding the activity, but no claim in this wiki tests it against a planned curriculum.
title: Emergent Curriculum
